arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc WHERE c.description = 'Grocery Stores, Supermarkets'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions whose merchant falls in the 'Grocery Stores, Supermarkets' merchant category.
assumptions: Counts all transactions regardless of whether they have a fraud label, since the question asks for total transactions.
Includes transactions with negative amounts, since they are counted as transactions.
